component.name: Yar
component.summary: Your friend for apps on Linux

description.p: Yar (the Persian word for "friend") shows everything installed on your computer in one place, whether it came from your distribution, from Flathub, from the Snap Store or from a file you downloaded yourself, and explains it in plain language.

ul.li: See every app, where it came from, where it lives and what it may reach
Browse a store that lists each app once, however many sources offer it
Understand, add and switch the sources your apps come from
See which updates are waiting and where your disk space goes

description.p: Yar is in early development. It does not install or remove apps yet.
